# Washington Trails Association

> WTA is Washington's premier resource for trail discovery, hiking guides, and grassroots advocacy to protect public lands and connect diverse communities to the outdoors.

The Washington Trails Association (WTA) operates as a membership-driven nonprofit focused on maintaining trails, advocating for public lands protection, and building inclusive outdoor access across Washington state. The organization combines practical hiking resources with conservation campaigns and youth leadership development.

## Explore Trails & Hiking

- [Hiking Guide](https://www.wta.org/go-outside/hikes): Comprehensive Washington trail database with search filters and regional hiking resources.
- [Go Outside](https://www.wta.org/go-outside): Main hub for hiking guides, trail finder, trip reports and outdoor resources.
- [Trip Reports](https://www.wta.org/go-outside/trip-reports): User-submitted trip reports and hiking conditions across Washington regions.
- [Seasonal Hikes](https://www.wta.org/go-outside/seasonal-hikes): Seasonal hiking recommendations and trip planning guides for Washington trails.

## Our Mission & Work

- [Our Work](https://www.wta.org/our-work): WTA mission overview: connecting everyone to outdoors and building community for trails.
- [About Us](https://www.wta.org/our-work/about): WTA organization mission, history, and volunteer programs for trail advocacy.
- [Defend Washington's Wild and Iconic Places](https://www.wta.org/our-work/defending-washingtons-wild-and-iconic-places): Public lands advocacy and trail protection initiative for North Cascades and Mount Rainier.
- [Connect All Communities to Trails](https://www.wta.org/our-work/connecting-all-communities-to-trails): WTA initiative connecting diverse communities to trails through volunteer opportunities.
- [Inspire Next Generation Leaders](https://www.wta.org/our-work/inspiring-next-generation-leaders): Youth leadership programs and emerging leaders training for outdoor careers.
- [Build an Outdoors Movement](https://www.wta.org/our-work/building-an-outdoors-movement): Movement-building for trail conservation and public lands advocacy through membership.
- [Recent Campaign Victories](https://www.wta.org/our-work/our-work-recent-victories): WTA campaign accomplishments and trail advocacy victories with community partnerships.

## Hiking Resources & Safety

- [Trail Smarts](https://www.wta.org/go-outside/trail-smarts): Safety tips, Leave No Trace practices, and responsible hiking guidelines.
- [Passes and Permits](https://www.wta.org/go-outside/passes): Guide to Discover Pass, Northwest Forest Pass, and national park permits.
- [Ranger Station Info](https://www.wta.org/go-outside/ranger-station-info): Contact directory for ranger stations and land managers across Washington.

## News & Community

- [Stories & News](https://www.wta.org/news): Latest news, how-to advice, and articles about trails, hiking season and trail community issues.

## Get Involved

- [Donate to Appeal 2026 Spring](https://www.wta.org/donate): WTA campaign donation page for spring trail recovery and maintenance fundraising.
